description: This Java source file defines the `JspClassLoaderFilter` class, a servlet filter used in the OpenMRS project to set the thread's context class loader to the OpenMRS class loader during request processing, enabling JSPs to access module-defined EL functions.

classes.name: JspClassLoaderFilter
classes.description: A servlet filter that sets the thread's context class loader to OpenMRS class loader for JSP EL function access.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the filter; currently does nothing.

methods.name: doFilter
methods.description: Sets the current thread's context class loader to the OpenMRS class loader and continues the filter chain.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Performs cleanup when the filter is destroyed; currently does nothing.
